row.title: OpenAlex now needs an API key; Europe PMC carries the ledger meanwhile
row.body: Beat 3 showed the cause in OpenAlex's own words: 'Insufficient budget. This request has no API key'. The mailto polite pool no longer helps. Europe PMC answered (power-posing checked, 6 leads refused by the verbatim-quote rule because they do not say they replicate). Europe PMC is now read most-cited first, and originals it does not hold are searched by name. The Worker reads OPENALEX_API_KEY when one is bound.
